As an operator, you’ll work in the hub of an innovative recycling company that transforms old foam materials into new end products such as carpet underlays and insulation panels. The products are dismantled at other locations, and the recycled material is returned to the Alphen aan den Rijn site as large foam blocks (up to 5,500 kilos each). That’s where your work begins. You’ll be responsible for operating various machines in the production line, including the flake mill, mixing chamber, pouring cylinder, and laminating machine. You’ll feed the machines with recycled foam, set them correctly, and monitor the process closely. By following instructions accurately, you help ensure the quality of the final product. You’ll also handle the timely supply of raw materials and semi-finished products using a forklift. No forklift certificate yet? No problem, you can obtain it through Luba.The company works with two shifts, but you will only work the evening shift, from 15:00 to 00:00. As the company is growing rapidly, the work environment is dynamic and developing. The day shift currently consists of 15 employees, while the evening shift has just 3. You will be part of the growing evening shift, which will eventually expand to a team of around 15 people, with all five machines operating, just like during the day shift.During the process, the foam is shredded, glued, steamed, and laminated. You make sure the right materials are available, machines are running properly, and you take action when needed. You work carefully and keep your workplace clean and safe. Together with your colleagues, you ensure everything runs smoothly and efficiently. Working hours are from 14.45-2345., with an evening shift allowance starting from 19:00.- Physically fit, eager to learn, and precise- You speak Dutch or fluently English- Responsible and tidy worker- Forklift certificate or willing to obtain one through Luba- Willing to work from 14.45-2345.
